metadata.methods_description: Seven healthy adults (ages 20-30) completed nine sessions each, comprising a motor imagery calibration phase (training) without feedback and a closed-loop trial phase with 12 trials per session, followed by extended 6-minute walk and stop motor imagery tasks. Recordings included 60-channel scalp EEG plus 4 EOG channels, IMU sensors (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, quaternion) mounted on the forehead and exoskeleton back brace, and logged exoskeleton control/feedback signals. Data are provided raw, without filtering or artifact removal.
